plan_review.notes: Adversarial review rejected the initial sidecar-heavy single-system plan. Alt A explicit floor-scoped ECS markers plus split pre/post authority was adopted. Alt B reuse generic combatant AI mode was partially rejected because generic Enemy tagging would cause AI/drop leakage, but existing path/passability and applyDamage are still reused. Alt C authored lane waypoints was rejected in favor of per-minion shared tile pathfinding (findTilePath) as the movement model, deferring cached/waypoint routing. Resolutions: add SiegeMinion/SiegeStructure markers; split siegeMinionSystem pre-step from floor5ObjectiveTick post-damage captures/audits/terminal; add Floor 5 progress telemetry; use stable manifest slot ids with transient EIDs; make command post entity health authoritative; audit combat events/health deltas independently; pin ScenarioDefinition ordering; keep generic combat/pathfinding changes minimal.

findings.detail: spawnFloor5Minion and updateFloor5Checkpoint each recompute computeSiegeCastleLayout(siegeCastleOptionsFromConfig(buildFloor5MapConfig())) from scratch on every spawn/tick. It is deterministic and bounded (<=4 minions) so not a correctness bug, but it is redundant work; compute the layout once during initializeFloor5Scenario and store it on the siege state (or a memoized module cache) and reuse it.

The combat-event audit resets combatEventCursor to 0 whenever combatEvents[cursor-1] !== lastCombatEvent. If the render layer drains and then refills world.combatEvents to the same length with different objects inside a single tick, the mismatch forces a full rescan and could re-count already-audited legal/illegal events (telemetry only, not gameplay). Consider keying staleness on a monotonic event id/sequence rather than the last-object reference to make the audit robust to same-length refills.

independent_grade.notes: The diff implements the Floor 5 lane-war slice cleanly and stays tightly scoped to that task. siegeMinionSystem is wired into the real ScenarioDefinition beforeEnemyAISystems slot and floor5ObjectiveTick via floorObjectiveTick, so behavior runs through the shared game/headless pipeline rather than a lab only; the floor1-main-scene-options test is updated to match the wiring. Determinism is preserved (SeededRandom for the frozen wave manifest, world.elapsedMs/frameCount for timing, deterministic query+sort ordering, no Math.random/Date.now), layer boundaries hold, and siege actors avoid generic Enemy tagging per the ADR. Edge cases are handled and tested: same-post-damage-tick Command Post defeat precedence, stale/recycled structure EID revalidation, bounded per-team spawn debt with manifest-index preservation, and the drained combat-event cursor staleness reset. The new headless lane-war test and the two foundation tests exercise every changed behavior and would fail without the change. The only issues found are minor performance/robustness nits (redundant layout recomputation and a telemetry double-count edge on same-length event refills); no criterion scores below 3 and no blocker exists, so the verdict is pass.
